# www.shanghai-restaurant.com
Expert-curated guide to Shanghai restaurants and cuisine: hand-picked, personally vetted, editorially independent recommendations for international travelers.

## Top-Level Guides
- [Home — Shanghai Restaurant Guide](https://www.shanghai-restaurant.com/): Ranked guide to the 15 best Shanghai restaurants, must-try dishes, districts, and dining occasions.
- [Xiaolongbao Guide](https://www.shanghai-restaurant.com/xiaolongbao/): The ultimate Shanghai soup dumpling guide — history, how to eat, and where to find them.
- [Shanghai Hairy Crab Guide](https://www.shanghai-restaurant.com/hairy-crab/): When and how to eat da zha xie, and the best places to try it.
- [Shengjianbao Guide](https://www.shanghai-restaurant.com/shengjianbao/): Shanghai pan-fried soup dumplings — what they are and where to eat them.
- [Red-Braised Pork (Hongshao Rou)](https://www.shanghai-restaurant.com/red-braised-pork/): The iconic Benbang dish — history, how to order, and where to find the best.
- [Shanghai Dim Sum Guide](https://www.shanghai-restaurant.com/shanghai-dim-sum/): Dim sum and point-style eating in Shanghai.
- [Shanghai Restaurant Prices](https://www.shanghai-restaurant.com/shanghai-restaurant-prices/): What a meal really costs across budgets in Shanghai.
- [Reservation Guide](https://www.shanghai-restaurant.com/reservations/): How to book a table at top Shanghai restaurants as a foreigner.
- [About](https://www.shanghai-restaurant.com/about/): Who we are and how our recommendations are vetted.

## Restaurants (individual profiles)
Each restaurant has a full profile linked from the homepage (https://www.shanghai-restaurant.com/). Example: https://www.shanghai-restaurant.com/restaurant/din-tai-fung/ for Din Tai Fung. Profiles also exist for jia-jia-tang-bao, old-jesse, fu-he-hui, yangs-fried-dumpling, lost-heaven, yongfoo-elite, xin-rong-ji, nanxiang, mercato, dexingguan, funkadeli, ren-he-guan, haifuduo, and guangmingcun.

## About
We're an independent editorial guide to Shanghai cuisine and restaurants. Our team researches, visits, and reviews the best Shanghai restaurants to help you find authentic Shanghainese food.
